statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.136 (Vanishing of the specified linear-channel determinant).** *Let $V$ be a vector space over $\mathbb{Q}$, let $e:V\to\mathbb{Q}$ be linear, and let $(\ell_j)_{j\in\iota}$ be a finite family of linear functionals vanishing on $\ker e$. For any vectors $(v_i)_{i\in\iota}$, the matrix $(\ell_j(v_i))_{i,j\in\iota}$ has rank at most one, so every square minor of size at least two vanishes. Indeed, the functionals descend to $V/\ker e$, which has dimension at most one. This elementary linear-algebra argument applies at every matrix size. It does not cover additional functionals that fail to vanish on $\ker e$.*
